title: 해양경찰위원회 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Chairperson)
(1) The chairperson of the Coast Guard Committee established under Article 5 (1) of the Coast Guard Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"; and the "Committee", respectively) shall represent the Committee and exercise overall control over its affairs.
(2) The chairperson shall be elected by and from among the members of the Committee.
(3) Where the chairperson is unable to perform his or her duties for unavoidable reasons, a member designated in advance by the chairperson shall act on his or her behalf.
